clues.text: On Paul's voyage toward Italy, his ship sailed in the shelter of this island, opposite Salmone.
At Pentecost in Jerusalem, people from this island heard the apostles declaring God's wonders in their own tongue.
Phoenix, the harbor where Paul's shipmates hoped to spend the winter, lay on this island facing southwest and northwest.
Paul wrote to Titus that one of this island's own prophets called its people always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.
A cyclone called the Northeaster swept down across this island and caught the ship carrying Paul.
After days without food in the storm, Paul told the sailors they should have listened and not left this island.
Paul left Titus on this island to set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town.
